pr.title: Refactor pagination helper
pr.body: page(items, number, size): number is zero-based and size is positive; return up to size items.

base_files.module.py:
def page(items, number, size):
    return items[number * size:(number + 1) * size]

head_files.module.py:
def page(items, number, size):
    start = number * size
    stop = start + size - 1
    return items[start:stop]

changed_files.patch:
--- a/module.py
+++ b/module.py
@@ -1,2 +1,4 @@
 def page(items, number, size):
-    return items[number * size:(number + 1) * size]
+    start = number * size
+    stop = start + size - 1
+    return items[start:stop]

gold_issues.description: The exclusive slice endpoint is reduced by one, omitting the final item of each full page.

findings.description: The slicing logic is incorrect. The stop index should be exclusive, but the current implementation includes the last item due to the '- 1' adjustment.
